findings.evidence: Reviewed current HMC/HTOR catalog and the linked two-page contactor insert, including scanned tables. They provide wire capacities, terminal dimensions and torque; no barrel or stripping length established for the installed HMC-9B/HTOR32 terminals. Ring-terminal width and general dimensions are not ferrule lengths.
Revisited DOLD product downloads and HC3096N datasheet. Solid/flexible 0.5-2.5 mm2, captive slotted screws, 0.5 Nm; no strip or ferrule barrel length.

BACO 0172001 product page, catalog 803 (printed pages 196-199), quick-reference and handle booklet identify the 25A/32A family and stranded wire with cap capacities, but no insertion/strip/barrel length.

Eaton exact RM25030-3SR page and family customer drawing identify SR as screw and PR as pressure plate. AD Class R block specification printed page tCPR-229 calls out ring or fork terminals to fit #10-32 screw. Recommendation: use appropriate 14 AWG ring/fork termination for the installed SR hardware rather than assigning a ferrule barrel. No change made to FH1 fields in this task; saved ferrule fields remain pending correction.

next_evidence_needed: Manufacturer-specified ferrule metal length or terminal insertion/contact-depth measurements for HMC coil/aux/main, HTOR aux/output, DOLD module, BACO disconnect. Do not infer a length solely from wire gauge or ferrule catalog availability.

FH1_owner_followup.selection: All six FH1 ends now ring terminal, 14 AWG; stud=#10-32; OD<=9 mm. Supersedes the pending-correction status at the earlier research checkpoint.
